name: Shanmugasundaram Selvam
profile: Long-time non-executive, non-independent director of Sun TV Network (on the board from 10 Aug 2009) and a major shareholder (67.7 lakh shares). Died suddenly on 10 October 2024, per Sun TV's FY2024-25 annual report.
notes: Deceased 10 Oct 2024. Source: Sun TV Network Annual Report 2024-25 (NSE), https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/SUNTV1_28082025163743_Annual_Report_2024-25.pdf

name: Matthew J. Missad
current_role: Executive Chairman, UFP Industries (Grand Rapids, MI); agreed to stay through 2026
profile: Career-long UFP Industries executive (wood/composite building, packaging and industrial products). He was EVP and general counsel from 1996, CEO from July 2011 to Dec 2024 and chairman from 2023. He became executive chairman when Will Schwartz took over as CEO at the start of fiscal 2025.
interesting_fact: Became UFP's fifth CEO in its history (July 2011) after more than 25 years at the company, much of it as its top lawyer.
deep_cut_fact: Started at UFP in 1978 as a high-school student working part-time on the maintenance crew. He paid his own way through college and law school, then joined full-time in 1985 as manager of legal compliance.
notes: Press contact (Lynn Afendoulis, Director of Corporate Communications) comes from a Feb 2023 release; check a recent UFP release to confirm it is current.
